text: {"assertions":["On 2026-01-28, a flapping flag bug was fixed in platform/featureflags/eval.go where flag evaluation decisions alternated between different results on successive calls.","The flapping flag issue occurred specifically when the input list was empty.","The root cause was a missing composite database index on columns (tenant_id, created_at).","The fix involved adding the composite index and backfilling data in batches, completed in PR #2674 on branch fix/flapping-flag-1.","The bug could be reproduced by repeatedly evaluating the same flag for a single user.","After the fix, the error rate dropped from 3.5% to under 5 per 10,000 (0.05%).","The flag evaluator is implemented in Go and has test coverage in platform/featureflags/eval_test.go."]}
